name: Typebot
description: Conversational form and chatbot builder for creating interactive flows embeddable on any site.

envVars.description: Secret used to encrypt stored credentials
Secret used to sign authentication sessions

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://typebot:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/typebot"
      ENCRYPTION_SECRET: {{env.ENCRYPTION_SECRET}}
      NEXTAUTH_SECRET: {{env.NEXTAUTH_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/app/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: typebot
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: typebot
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-viewer:
    image: baptistearno/typebot-viewer:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-viewer
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: "postgresql://typebot:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/typebot"
